data.name: Malaikataht
data.gender_notes: Malaikataht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Malaikataht is derived from the Arabic word 'Malaika' which means 'Angel'. The 'taht' suffix is added to denote the concept of 'littleness'. Thus, the name Malaikataht means 'Little Angel'. The name Malaikataht carries the meaning “Little Angel” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Malaikataht usually hope their child will grow to embody little angel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Malaikataht is a name that symbolizes the divine presence and protection of angels in a child's life. It is a name that inspires a sense of spirituality and closeness to the divine.
data.etymology: Malaikataht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Angel.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Malaikataht total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: ملائكته
in_arabic.meaning: ملائكة الله تعالى أو رسل الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ملائكته مشتق من كلمة ملائكة وهي جمع ملاك، وتعني رسل الله أو عباده المقربون، وقد ورد ذكر الملائكة في القرآن الكريم في العديد من السور، مثل سورة البقرة وسورة آل عمران، وهم يعتقد أنهم يقومون بتنفيذ أوامر الله تعالى

in_urdu.name: ملائکہت
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کے فرشتے یا اللہ کے رسول
in_urdu.long_meaning: ملائکہت نام ملائکہ سے ماخوذ ہے جو ملاک کی جمع ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کے رسول یا مقرب عبادتگزار، قرآن مجید میں فرشتوں کا ذکر کئی سورتوں میں کیا گیا ہے، جیسے سورہ البقرة وسورہ آل عمران، اور یہ माना جاتا ہے کہ وہ اللہ تعالیٰ کے احکام پر عمل پیرا ہیں

Hence, the name Malaikataht holds a special place in Islamic culture and serves as a reminder of the divine beings that surround us.

Additionally, the name can inspire individuals to embody the virtues of Angels, such as obedience to Allah and compassion towards others.
